// diagnostic

E0225

This `&` or `^` mark does not match a call or move that writes or takes the marked place.

What

This `&` or `^` mark does not match a call or move that writes or takes the marked place.

Why

A mark belongs only on a named place that a call writes or takes, or that `^` moves as a value. Read calls and fresh values such as literals and call results take no mark, and a collection element stays in its collection.

Fix

Remove the mark.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0225: tests/ui/E0225_read_param_takes_amp.stderr.

Error [jet.UnusedPlaceMark]: `show` only reads this argument, so it takes no `&` mark
  --> tests/ui/E0225_read_param_takes_amp.jet:7:10
    |
  7 |     show(&x)
    |          ^
 Why: A mark shows that a call writes (`&`) or takes (`^`) the named place; `show` declares this parameter read-only, so the call leaves the place unmarked
 Fix: Remove `&`
